"""Freeze a new numeric endpoint-consequence maintenance study, without inference."""
import copy
import hashlib
import json
from collections import Counter
from work import ROOT, read, save, now
from ainglish import panel
from ainglish.reader_qualification import validate_screen

PID = 'a-v6srdj64msfdqzy5'
POST = 'bf880364-9f77-46cc-b889-a2fafbfcf3f7'
SEED = 202609191002
FORMS = [('include-both', (1, 1)), ('include-start-only', (1, 0)),
         ('include-end-only', (0, 1)), ('exclude-both', (0, 0))]
FRAMES = [('archived folios', 28, 73), ('specimen drawers', 46, 91),
          ('audio clips', 17, 62), ('exhibition panels', 35, 84),
          ('fabric swatches', 23, 58), ('catalogue cards', 41, 96),
          ('photo proofs', 32, 79), ('workshop benches', 14, 67)]


def digest(x):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(x, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()


def pairs(x):
    if isinstance(x, dict):
        if isinstance(x.get('english'), str) and isinstance(x.get('ainglish'), str):
            yield x['english'], x['ainglish']
        for v in x.values():
            yield from pairs(v)
    elif isinstance(x, list):
        for v in x:
            yield from pairs(v)


def joint_options(x, y):
    return [f'{a} then {b}' for a, b in ((x, x), (x, y), (y, x), (y, y))]


def controls(prefix, count, x, y):
    out = []
    for j in range(count):
        bits = FORMS[j % 4][1]
        dest = [x if bit else y for bit in bits]
        other = [y if dest[0] == x else x, dest[1]]
        opts = joint_options(x, y)
        answer = f'{dest[0]} then {dest[1]}'
        pos = (j // 4 + j) % 4
        opts = [answer] + [v for v in opts if v != answer]
        opts = opts[-pos:] + opts[:-pos] if pos else opts
        out.append({'id': f'{prefix}-{j:02}',
                    'detectable': f'Assignment slip {prefix}-{810+j}: parcel Q has destination {dest[0]}; parcel R has destination {dest[1]}.',
                    'other': f'Assignment slip {prefix}-{810+j}: parcel Q has destination {other[0]}; parcel R has destination {other[1]}.',
                    'question': 'What are the recorded destinations, first for parcel Q and then for parcel R?',
                    'options': opts, 'answer': answer})
    return out


def main():
    assert not (ROOT / 'frozen-design-v2.json').exists(), 'Never overwrite a frozen design.'
    assert not (ROOT / 'qualification-start.json').exists(), 'No redesign after exposure.'
    readers = [
        {'name': 'Excelsior-Range-Gemma-20260919', 'provider': 'ollama',
         'model': 'dexagon-gemma3-12b-pp-task:ctx4k', 'precision': 'Q4_K_M',
         'api': 'openai', 'base_url': 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1',
         'max_tokens': 128, 'timeout_s': 120, 'temperature': 0, 'top_p': 1, 'seed': SEED},
        {'name': 'Excelsior-Range-Mistral-20260919', 'provider': 'ollama',
         'model': 'dexagon-mistral-small3.2-24b-pp-task:ctx4k', 'precision': 'Q4_K_M',
         'api': 'openai', 'base_url': 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1',
         'max_tokens': 128, 'timeout_s': 120, 'temperature': 0, 'top_p': 1, 'seed': SEED},
    ]
    panel.prepare_reader_instruments({'panel': readers})
    items, allocation = [], []
    for direction in ('ascending', 'descending'):
        for form_index, (form, bits) in enumerate(FORMS):
            stratum = f'{form}-{direction}'
            for j, (noun, low, high) in enumerate(FRAMES):
                a, b = (low, high) if direction == 'ascending' else (high, low)
                common = 'The named numbers are valid item identifiers. A range may be written in either direction.\n'
                stem = f'Select {noun} in the range {a} to {b}'
                mapping = { 'include-both': f'Both {a} and {b} are members.',
                            'include-start-only': f'{a} is a member and {b} is not.',
                            'include-end-only': f'{a} is not a member and {b} is.',
                            'exclude-both': 'Neither is a member.'}[form]
                english = common + stem + '. ' + mapping
                ainglish = common + stem + ', ' + form + '.'
                # The held-out sorting rule lives only in the question. The
                # decisive destination vocabulary is absent from both messages.
                selected, rejected = ('copper', 'linen') if j % 2 == 0 else ('linen', 'copper')
                question = (f'A sorter sends a selected item to the {selected} tray and an unselected item to the {rejected} tray. '
                            f'What destinations follow for item {a} and then item {b}, in that order?')
                answer = f'{selected if bits[0] else rejected} then {selected if bits[1] else rejected}'
                opts = joint_options('copper', 'linen')
                opts.remove(answer)
                pos = j // 2
                opts.insert(pos, answer)
                # For each reader/form/direction/answer-position block, assign
                # both arms. Reverse crossover in the upper four contexts so
                # each reader/arm also crosses the selected-tray mapping.
                want_first = 'ainglish' if ((j % 2) ^ (j // 4) ^ (form_index % 2) ^ (direction == 'descending')) == 0 else 'english'
                want = [want_first, 'english' if want_first == 'ainglish' else 'ainglish']
                nonce = 0
                while True:
                    iid = f'ex-range-{direction}-{form}-{j}-{nonce:04}'
                    if [panel.arm_for(SEED, r['name'], iid) for r in readers] == want:
                        break
                    nonce += 1
                item = {'id': iid, 'english': english, 'ainglish': ainglish,
                        'question': question, 'options': opts, 'answer': answer,
                        'settlement_stratum': stratum, 'form': form, 'direction': direction,
                        'frame_index': j, 'first_endpoint': a, 'second_endpoint': b,
                        'endpoint_bits': list(bits), 'selected_destination': selected,
                        'unselected_destination': rejected,
                        'key_basis': 'Registered written-endpoint membership bits, composed with the identical held-out sorting policy; no interior or traversal inference.'}
                assert all(v not in english and v not in ainglish for v in ('copper', 'linen'))
                assert len(set(opts)) == 4 and opts[pos] == answer
                items.append(item)
                allocation.append({'id': iid, 'stratum': stratum, 'frame_index': j,
                                   'key_position': pos, 'selected_destination': selected,
                                   'reader_arms': dict(zip([r['name'] for r in readers], want))})
    for r in readers:
        for stratum in sorted({i['settlement_stratum'] for i in items}):
            rows = [v for v in allocation if v['stratum'] == stratum]
            assert Counter((v['reader_arms'][r['name']], v['key_position']) for v in rows) == Counter({(arm, pos): 1 for arm in ('english', 'ainglish') for pos in range(4)})
            assert Counter((v['reader_arms'][r['name']], v['selected_destination']) for v in rows) == Counter({(arm, dest): 2 for arm in ('english', 'ainglish') for dest in ('copper', 'linen')})
        for j in range(8):
            for direction in ('ascending', 'descending'):
                rows = [v for v in allocation if v['frame_index'] == j and v['stratum'].endswith('-' + direction)]
                assert Counter(v['reader_arms'][r['name']] for v in rows) == Counter({'english': 2, 'ainglish': 2})
    cal = controls('EX-RANGE-CAL', 8, 'ceramic', 'satin')
    cal_items = [{'id': c['id'], 'calibration': True, 'ainglish': c['detectable'], 'english': c['other'],
                  **{k: c[k] for k in ('question', 'options', 'answer')}} for c in cal]
    qualification = controls('EX-RANGE-QUAL', 12, 'chalk', 'rubber')
    fresh = set(pairs(items))
    arms = {v for pair in fresh for v in pair}
    assert len(fresh) == 64 and len(arms) == 128
    overlap = {}
    for row in read('range-proposal')['measurements']:
        record = read('history-' + row['manifest_hash'])
        old = set(pairs(record['manifest']))
        assert old, 'A prior bank needs explicit inspection if not inline.'
        shared = fresh & old
        shared_arms = arms & {v for pair in old for v in pair}
        assert not shared and not shared_arms
        overlap[row['manifest_hash']] = {'pairs': len(old), 'shared_pairs': 0, 'shared_arms': 0}
    thread = '\n'.join(c['body'] for c in read('range-comments'))
    p = read('range-proposal')
    examples = p['example_english'] + p['example_ainglish'] + p['english_mapping']
    assert all(arm not in thread and arm not in examples for arm in arms)
    # Also check the case-specific instruction without the common lead-in.
    assert all(i['ainglish'].split('\n')[1] not in thread + examples for i in items)
    strata = [{'id': f'{form}-{direction}', 'weight': 1} for direction in ('ascending', 'descending') for form, _ in FORMS]
    m = {'construct': 'range endpoints: written order under ascending and descending numeric identifiers',
         'metric': 'comprehension_accuracy_delta', 'seed': SEED, 'panel': readers, 'items': items + cal_items,
         'comparator': {'kind': 'registered-endpoint-membership-mapping-v1',
                        'description': 'Apply the registered four membership definitions with A/B replaced by the actual written endpoints. Exact definition clauses are retained; no interval brackets or ambiguous bare comparator.'},
         'study_purpose': 'boundary_check',
         'study_scope': 'New maintenance ORIGINAL: 64 numeric-identifier instructions, 8 authored lexical frames crossed with 4 qualifiers and 2 written directions, two cold local reader editions. One held-out joint sorting consequence encodes both endpoint bits; this is not the filing\'s two separately queried yes/no/cannot-tell items or full seven-domain battery. Equal eight form/direction strata; both arms and all four key positions per reader/stratum, balanced downstream policy polarity. No marker gloss. Related frames limit independence; official item bootstrap is not frame-clustered. No bare-range, dates, corruption, fidelity, token, human, adoption or trained-reader claim. A null does not establish equivalence or the 5-point margin; keep ceiling and adverse outcomes.',
         'settlement_strata': strata,
         'calibration_min_gap': 0.5, 'calibration_min_recovered': 1.0, 'planted_arm': 'ainglish',
         'admissibility': {'kind': 'ainglish.panel.admissibility.v1', 'per_reader_calibration': True,
                           'max_off_option_cells': 0, 'max_absent_cells': 0, 'max_truncated_cells': 0, 'max_transport_fault_cells': 0}}
    screens = []
    for r in readers:
        screen = {'kind': 'ainglish.reader-qualification-screen.v1', 'roster_id': r['name'] + '@' + r['precision'],
                  'reader': copy.deepcopy(r),
                  'lineage': {'key': 'gemma3:12b' if 'Gemma' in r['name'] else 'mistral-small3.2:24b',
                              'basis': 'Different cached model families bound by full Ollama digest, with generic literal-reader wrappers. Both Q4_K_M, unknown training overlap; no measured error independence claim.'},
                  'controls': qualification, 'validity_days': 7, 'min_gap_bps': 5000, 'min_recovered_bps': 9500}
        validate_screen(screen)
        screens.append(screen)
    save('candidate-manifest', m)
    planned = panel._planned_panel_manifest(m)
    assert planned['item_counts'] == {'real': 64, 'calibration': 8}
    assert planned['calibration']['min_gap'] == 0.5 and planned['calibration']['min_recovered'] == 1.0
    pin = {'estimand': 'Equal-weight eight-stratum mean of marked-minus-complete-English exact joint endpoint-consequence accuracy, percentage points, under official formula v2. Each four-choice response encodes both endpoint selections via a held-out sorting rule. Separate form/direction and endpoint-bit diagnostics; original numeric maintenance slice, not replication or the entire proposed noninferiority battery.',
           'admissibility_gates': [
               'Same ratified revision and authenticated maintenance task remain available, with no newly announced hold or overlapping experiment.',
               'Exact two digest-bound local readers pass fresh target-independent qualification before scientific mint.',
               '64 complete novel pairs, 8 equal form/direction strata, balanced reader/arm/key-position and downstream-policy polarity allocation frozen before inference.',
               'Shared reference validity and host direction allowance do not define the construct; option vocabulary appears in neither message arm; gold follows registered bits plus held-out sorting rule.',
               'Eight experimental controls per reader in both arms must pass gap >=0.5 and recovered headroom >=1; 128 scientific cells run once with no retries.',
               'Any missing, off-option, truncated or failed transport cell yields a typed stop. Preserve every null, adverse or supportive finite result without exclusion, reallocation, enlargement or rerun.',
           ],
           'planned_sample': {'scientific_items': 64, 'scientific_calls': 128, 'panel_control_items': 8,
                              'panel_control_calls': 32, 'qualification_controls': 12, 'qualification_calls': 48,
                              'max_total_calls': 208, 'lexical_frames': 8, 'form_direction_strata': 8,
                              'items_per_stratum': 8, 'bootstrap_draws': 2000, 'items_sha256': planned['items_sha256']},
           'proposal_revision': p['slug']}
    save('frozen-design-v2', {'time': now(), 'manifest': m, 'screens': screens, 'pin': pin,
                           'allocation': allocation, 'overlap': overlap,
                           'pre_exposure_design_history': 'An initial zero-call preview rejected slash-containing stratum identifiers; these were changed to hyphens before a successful draft preview. This final v2 also crosses arms within each reader/lexical-frame/direction block rather than fixing one arm per reader/frame across the whole battery. The earlier local draft is retained; neither draft was publicly minted or exposed to a reader.',
                           'budget': 'Maximum 208 calls to existing local models; no downloads, hosted charges, retries or enlargement.'})
    save('preview-before-qualification-v2', planned)
    print(json.dumps({'items_sha256': planned['items_sha256'], 'sample': pin['planned_sample'],
                      'calibration': planned['calibration'], 'history_banks_checked': len(overlap)}, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
